frases.texto: Nonnegative Matrix Factorization in Dimensionality Reduction: A Survey
this article presents a comprehensive survey of NMF, focusing on its applications in both feature extraction and feature selection
Nonnegative Matrix Factorization (NMF) has emerged as a popular and powerful method for dimensionality reduction
